name: Houndmaster's Whistle refuses a dead Shadowhound, which comes back through Call From The Shadows (#7443)
contract: Houndmaster's Whistle 801343 summons the Shadowhound 50124 and teaches Call From The Shadows 578118, which
resurrects it ('bringing back your Shadow Hound from the dead'). A hound that dies is removed and saved with 0
health, and the Whistle loaded it at full health, so a dead hound was whistled back at once. Like a stock hunter's
Call Pet, the Whistle now refuses while the hound is dead (SPELL_FAILED_DONT_REPORT 27 after the native 'Your pet
is dead' message) and summons nothing. Expected: the hound dies and is removed; the Whistle then fails with 27 and
no hound appears; Call From The Shadows brings the hound back.
